title: Kedgeree
steps: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and peel. Simmer fish with bay leaves in water for 5 minutes until cooked, then flake into chunks.
Cook rice in salted water for 10 minutes, drain, and chill. Melt ghee in a pan, soften chopped ginger, onion, and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add curry powder and mustard seeds, cooking briefly. Stir in chopped tomatoes and lemon juice, then gently heat through the fish and rice.
Quarter the boiled eggs, then gently fold them into the warm rice mixture along with most of the fresh coriander and chopped red chilli.
Mix remaining coriander into the yoghurt. Serve the warm kedgeree immediately alongside the herbed yoghurt for a complete flavorful meal.
